evidence_boundary: All quantities are design-envelope values unless explicitly marked observed. No field observation, permit, owner consent, operator appointment, procurement quote, or professional sign-off is claimed.

concept.decision_rule_zh: AI服务只有在无障碍、无AI等价路径、数据最小化、具名人工负责和可撤回五道门均通过后，才可取得公共空间的限时试用权。
concept.decision_rule_en: An AI service receives a time-limited right to use public space only after passing accessibility, non-AI equivalence, data minimisation, named human accountability, and reversibility gates.

gates.pass_evidence: Licensed accessibility audit and route walk-through; zero blocking break on the protected route.
gates.stop_condition: Any user must enter mixed traffic or cannot reach the same destination.

gates.pass_evidence: Same-task manual route completed without account, device, biometric data, or AI output.
gates.stop_condition: AI shutdown prevents access to the underlying public service.

gates.pass_evidence: Published data inventory, retention period, processor, purpose, deletion route, and privacy review.
gates.stop_condition: Unlisted personal-data collection or unresolved high-risk privacy finding.

gates.pass_evidence: Named accountable operator per shift, visible contact, incident log, and appeal handoff.
gates.stop_condition: No authorised human can pause the service or decide an appeal.

gates.pass_evidence: Timed removal drill restores the baseline path and leaves no inaccessible or unsafe residue.
gates.stop_condition: Removal cannot restore the baseline service within the approved closure window.

first_release.candidate_location: One existing ground-floor bay inside the provisional Beijing AI Origin Community; exact address remains unselected pending owner consent, fire/access survey, and official boundary confirmation.
first_release.single_decision_owner: The legally authorised facility operator; no programme office or AI system may substitute for this role.
first_release.baseline_sample: Six observation days: four weekdays and two weekend days; three daily windows; at least 60 same-task attempts split between manual and assisted routes; include wheelchair/mobility-aid and low-digital-skill participants through accessible recruitment.

effect_evaluation.allocation: Block-randomize 60 same-task attempts: 30 staffed manual-route attempts and 30 AI-assisted-route attempts, balanced within each time window.
effect_evaluation.strata: 36 general-user attempts, 12 low-digital-skill attempts, and 12 wheelchair or mobility-aid attempts; split each stratum equally between routes.
effect_evaluation.evaluation_role: Exploratory feasibility sample only. The 60 attempts cannot establish statistical noninferiority or justify expansion.
effect_evaluation.descriptive_continuation_signals: Report observed completion-rate differences against descriptive signals of -5 percentage points overall and -10 points within each priority stratum; median completion time or staff interventions per completed task should improve by at least 10%. Passing any signal authorizes only design refinement, never scale.
effect_evaluation.confirmatory_requirement: Before any expansion, an independent statistician must preregister the primary outcome, one-sided alpha, at least 80% power, expected staffed-route completion, attrition, confidence-interval method, and resulting total and stratum sample sizes. Expansion requires the adequately powered confirmatory result plus every safety gate.
effect_evaluation.missing_data: Withdrawal, missing outcome, or route crossover counts as incomplete in the primary analysis; also publish an as-treated sensitivity table.
effect_evaluation.frontline_workload: Observed frontline minutes per completed task must not rise by more than 10%; safety and human stop authority override every descriptive signal.
